title: Twist product
description: JSON Schema for the twist-product construction's input data: a single bounded lattice L (carrier + meet + join). The output bilattice L^⋈ is derived by the construction script; its data shape conforms to bilattice.schema.json with carrier L × L. The lattice axioms (idempotence, commutativity, associativity, absorption) are not expressible in JSON Schema and must be checked by a verifier.

carrier.description: The lattice's underlying set L as a finite array of distinct symbolic values.

meet.description: ⊓ : L × L → L; meet[a][b] is a ⊓ b.

join.description: ⊔ : L × L → L; join[a][b] is a ⊔ b.

bottom.description: Optional bottom element of L (the bottom of the lattice order). Required for the twist product to be a bounded pre-bilattice.
